title.narrative: Supporting the development of industrial zones in Lebanon # Phase II

description.narrative: Building on the results of Phase I of the #Supporting the development of Industrial Zones in Lebanon# project, the proposed project phase II aims at continuing the assistance to the Country and the Ministry of Industry in establishing modern industrial zones in Lebanon. The project will be tasked to: # Provide technical assistance and advisor support to the Government of Lebanon in implementing the master-plans designed during phase I of the project and in deploying a National Industrial Zones development strategy; # Provide the Ministry of Industry with capacity building and advisory support industrial zones development and management.
